title: BACKND Base cash / TBC (discontinued)
summary: Game cash items and TBC (The Backend Cash): list cash items, recharge TBC, purchase with TBC, and query TBC balance. Note: TBC has been discontinued due to receipt-verification modernization and is only usable on SDK 5.18.7 and below.
capabilities: recognize cash/TBC questions and flag the discontinuation
route legacy TBC integrations to the cash family
redirect new purchase work to the receipt topic
prerequisites: An existing integration targets SDK 5.18.7 or below for TBC
Cash items are configured in the console
common_pitfalls: Recommending TBC for new work (discontinued; SDK 5.18.7 or below only)
Assuming TBC works on current SDK versions
Confusing TBC purchase with store receipt validation
verification_required_for: exact discontinuation scope and SDK version cutoff
whether any TBC API remains callable on the target SDK
verification_strategy: Use https://docs.backnd.com plus the source route to confirm the TBC discontinuation notice and version cutoff before advising.
For new purchase features, route to the receipt topic instead of TBC.
public_notes: TBC is discontinued and limited to SDK 5.18.7 and below; do not recommend for new work.
Use the receipt topic for current purchase/verification flows.
